overall.description: One plain sentence: how the contract measures up to the purchasing policy, naming the rules it falls short of or is missing.

findings.description: One finding for each rule of the purchasing policy, in the policy's order.

rule.description: The rule's name, exactly as the policy writes it.

contract_says.description: What the contract says on the rule's topic, close to its own words. Null if it says nothing.

note.description: One plain sentence saying why the result follows, written before the result is chosen.

result.description: How the contract measures up to the rule: the result the note supports.
